summary.zh: 由土地灣直上打爛埕頂山，沿港島東南稜線起伏而行，山海左右夾擊，最後落大浪灣衝浪灘。曾被《時代周刊》選為亞洲市區最佳遠足徑。
summary.en: A ridge walk above Shek O with sea on both sides, climbing to Shek O Peak before dropping to Big Wave Bay. Once picked by TIME as Asia's best urban hike.

highlights.zh: 打爛埕頂山 284 米稜線，270° 海景
highlights.en: 284 m ridge with a 270° sea panorama

highlights.zh: 龍脊草原段，秋冬金黃一片
highlights.en: Golden grassland along the Dragon's Back in autumn

highlights.zh: 終點大浪灣可落水或歎咖啡
highlights.en: Finish with a swim or coffee at Big Wave Bay

startTransport.zh: 城巴 9 號（筲箕灣 ↔ 石澳）「土地灣」落車
startTransport.en: Citybus 9 (Shau Kei Wan ↔ Shek O), alight at To Tei Wan

endTransport.zh: 大浪灣乘 9 號或紅色小巴回筲箕灣
endTransport.en: Bus 9 or red minibus from Big Wave Bay to Shau Kei Wan

note.en: Water and hot food at the finish

note.zh: 可沿石澳道落大浪灣或上引水道
note.en: Escape down to Shek O Road

district.en: Wong Tai Sin · Sha Tin Pass

summary.zh: 香港最著名的一塊石。由天馬苑拾級而上，最後一段手腳並用攀上獅頭，九龍半島與沙田谷一線之隔，落山接回歸亭往沙田坳。
summary.en: Hong Kong's most famous rock. Stairs from Tin Ma Court, a short scramble onto the lion's head, then the Kowloon skyline on one side and Sha Tin valley on the other.

highlights.zh: 獅頭石位置俯瞰九龍全景
highlights.en: The lion's head viewpoint over Kowloon
Sunset and city lights from the Reunification Pavilion

highlights.zh: 接沙田坳道，可加遊慈雲山
highlights.en: Link to Sha Tin Pass and Tsz Wan Shan

startTransport.zh: 樂富站 A 出口步行 15 分鐘至天馬苑
startTransport.en: Lok Fu MTR exit A, 15 min walk to Tin Ma Court

endTransport.zh: 沙田坳道乘小巴往黃大仙／慈雲山
endTransport.en: Minibus from Sha Tin Pass Road to Wong Tai Sin

note.zh: 起點有飲品機及洗手間
note.en: Drinks machine and toilets at the start

note.zh: 可折返天馬苑或落竹園
note.en: Return to Tin Ma Court or drop to Chuk Yuen

name.zh: 麥理浩徑第一段 · 萬宜東壩

summary.zh: 沿萬宜水庫車路緩上，兩旁是六角柱石與海蝕地貌，東壩的防波堤錨形石是打卡位，末段落浪茄。全程無樹蔭，夏天要早起步。
summary.en: A gentle road walk around High Island Reservoir, past hexagonal columns and the famous dolos dam, finishing at Long Ke beach. No shade at all — start early in summer.

highlights.zh: 東壩錨形石防波堤與六角柱石
highlights.en: The dolos dam and hexagonal rock columns
Finish at Long Ke's white-sand bay

startTransport.zh: 94 號巴士（西貢 ↔ 黃石碼頭）北潭涌下車
startTransport.en: Bus 94 (Sai Kung ↔ Wong Shek) to Pak Tam Chung

endTransport.zh: 浪茄無交通，需沿麥徑二段走回東壩或乘的士（東壩有電召的士站）
endTransport.en: No transport at Long Ke; walk back to the East Dam for taxis

note.zh: 電召的士或原路折返北潭涌
note.en: Call a taxi or walk back to Pak Tam Chung

name.zh: 麥理浩徑第二段 · 大浪四灣
name.en: MacLehose Trail Section 2 · Tai Long Bays

summary.zh: 公認全港最美一段：先攀西灣山，再沿大浪西灣、鹹田灣、大灣、東灣四個沙灘串走，最後經赤徑古道出北潭凹。
summary.en: Widely called Hong Kong's most beautiful hike: over Sai Wan Shan, then beach after beach — Tai Wan, Ham Tin, Tai Long, Tung Wan — before the old Kwun Yam path to Pak Tam Au.

highlights.zh: 西灣山 314 米回望四灣
highlights.en: Sai Wan Shan (314 m) over the four bays
Ham Tin's plank bridge and beach cafe

startTransport.zh: 94 號巴士至北潭涌，轉的士／步行至東壩起步；或由西灣亭走 30 分鐘落西灣
startTransport.en: Bus 94 to Pak Tam Chung, taxi to the East Dam; or start at Sai Wan Pavilion

endTransport.zh: 北潭凹乘 94／96R 巴士
endTransport.en: Bus 94/96R from Pak Tam Au

note.zh: 由西灣上西灣亭乘 29R 小巴

name.zh: 麥理浩徑第三段 · 嶂上高原

district.en: Pak Tam Au · Shui Long Wo

summary.zh: 連環上斜的體能段：牛耳石山、畫眉山、雷打石、雞公山四上四落，中段嶂上高原的平原與士多係最佳補給點。
summary.en: A leg-burning sequence of four climbs — Ngau Yue Shek Shan, Wa Mei Shan, Lui Ta Shek and Kai Kung Shan — with the Cheung Sheung plateau and its cafe midway.

highlights.zh: 嶂上高原草原與許林士多
highlights.en: Cheung Sheung plateau and its decades-old store

highlights.zh: 雞公山 399 米望西貢內海
highlights.en: Kai Kung Shan (399 m) over the Sai Kung inlet

startTransport.zh: 94／96R 巴士至北潭凹
startTransport.en: Bus 94/96R to Pak Tam Au

endTransport.zh: 水浪窩乘 299X 往沙田或西貢
endTransport.en: Bus 299X from Shui Long Wo to Sha Tin or Sai Kung

note.zh: 豆腐花、即食麵（主要假日）
note.en: Tofu pudding and noodles, mainly weekends

note.zh: 可沿榕樹澳古道落水浪窩
note.en: Descend via the Yung Shue O path

name.zh: 麥理浩徑第四段 · 馬鞍山
name.en: MacLehose Trail Section 4 · Ma On Shan

summary.zh: 由水浪窩直上馬鞍山腹地，經昂平高原、大金鐘瘠岩，再橫越大老山至基維爾營。全程稜線視野，西貢與沙田一覽無遺。
summary.en: A long climb into Ma On Shan's high country, past Ngong Ping plateau and the rocky Pyramid, then across Tate's Cairn. Ridge views over Sai Kung and Sha Tin throughout.

highlights.en: Ngong Ping plateau, a paragliding lawn

highlights.zh: 大老山雷達站與九龍遠景
highlights.en: Tate's Cairn radar station and Kowloon views

startTransport.zh: 299X 巴士至水浪窩
startTransport.en: Bus 299X to Shui Long Wo

endTransport.zh: 基維爾營步行 20 分鐘至飛鵝山道乘 91／92 號巴士
endTransport.en: 20 min walk from Gilwell Camp to Fei Ngo Shan Road for bus 91/92

note.en: Descend to Heng On or Sai Kung

name.zh: 麥理浩徑第七段 · 針山草山

summary.zh: 由城門水塘主壩直上針山 532 米的天梯，過草山 647 米，落鉛礦坳。短而陡，是練氣與看城門水塘全景的經典。
summary.en: A steep staircase from Shing Mun's main dam to Needle Hill (532 m), over Grassy Hill (647 m) and down to Lead Mine Pass — short, sharp and panoramic.

highlights.en: Shing Mun Reservoir and Tsuen Wan below

startTransport.zh: 82 號小巴（荃灣兆和街 ↔ 城門水塘）
startTransport.en: Minibus 82 (Tsuen Wan ↔ Shing Mun Reservoir)

endTransport.zh: 鉛礦坳沿衛奕信徑落大埔碗窰乘 23K 小巴
endTransport.en: Descend to Tai Po Wun Yiu for minibus 23K

name.zh: 麥理浩徑第八段 · 大帽山
name.en: MacLehose Trail Section 8 · Tai Mo Shan

district.en: Lead Mine Pass · Tsuen Kam Au

summary.zh: 香港最高一段：鉛礦坳上四方山，再攀 957 米大帽山頂的雷達球，沿車路落荃錦坳。天氣好可望深圳與大嶼山，冬天有霜。
summary.en: Hong Kong's highest section: from Lead Mine Pass over Sheung Fa Shan to the radar domes on Tai Mo Shan (957 m), then down the road to Tsuen Kam Au.

highlights.en: The territory's highest point at 957 m
Sheung Fa Shan's grassland and cairns
Frost and sea-of-cloud mornings in winter

startTransport.zh: 由城門水塘 82 號小巴起步，經麥徑七段接上
startTransport.en: Minibus 82 to Shing Mun, then MacLehose 7 to the pass

endTransport.zh: 荃錦坳乘 51 號巴士（荃灣 ↔ 錦田）
endTransport.en: Bus 51 (Tsuen Wan ↔ Kam Tin) from Tsuen Kam Au

summary.zh: 由大棠楓香林缓步而入，登清景台俯瞰大欖涌水塘的「千島」水線，再沿山徑落掃管笏。秋冬紅葉加湖景，是元朗最熱門的短途路線。
summary.en: An easy walk from Tai Tong's sweet gum woods to a platform over Tai Lam Chung Reservoir's island-studded water, then down to So Kwun Wat.

highlights.zh: 清景台 180° 水塘群島景
大棠楓香林紅葉（12 月至 1 月）
highlights.en: Sweet gum foliage in December and January

highlights.zh: 大欖涌水塘戰後水務遺蹟

startTransport.zh: 港鐵朗屏站轉 68R／的士至大棠山道
startTransport.en: MTR Long Ping, then bus 68R or taxi to Tai Tong Shan Road

endTransport.zh: 掃管笏乘 61M／53 號巴士往屯門或荃灣
endTransport.en: Bus 61M/53 from So Kwun Wat to Tuen Mun or Tsuen Wan

note.en: Back to Tai Tong the same way

summary.zh: 菠蘿壩起步，沿水塘道環走一圈，途經二戰城門碉堡、白千層林與猴子出沒的燒烤場。全程平坦，樹蔭充足，帶小朋友都行得完。
summary.en: A flat loop from Pineapple Dam past WWII pillboxes, paperbark groves and monkey-heavy picnic sites. Shaded and stroller-friendly most of the way.

startTransport.zh: 82 號小巴（荃灣兆和街 ↔ 城門水塘）
startTransport.en: Minibus 82 (Tsuen Wan ↔ Shing Mun Reservoir)

endTransport.zh: 同一小巴返回荃灣
endTransport.en: Same minibus back to Tsuen Wan

summary.zh: 秋冬芒草聖地。由伯公坳直上 869 米大東山，山脊兩旁是金黃色芒草海，爛頭營的百年石屋散落山腰，最後落南山。
summary.en: Hong Kong's silvergrass pilgrimage: from Pak Kung Au up to Sunset Peak (869 m), past the century-old stone huts of Sunset Villa, down to Nam Shan.

highlights.en: Silvergrass seas in November and December
Views to Lantau Peak and Pui O

startTransport.zh: 3M／11／23 號大嶼山巴士「伯公坳」下車
startTransport.en: Lantau bus 3M/11/23 to Pak Kung Au

endTransport.zh: 南山乘 3M／11 號巴士往梅窩或東涌
endTransport.en: Bus 3M/11 from Nam Shan to Mui Wo or Tung Chung

note.en: Descend via Wong Lung Hang Road

summary.zh: 香港第二高峰 934 米。由伯公坳上攀的「天梯」約 1,200 級，山頂可望鳳凰觀日與石壁水塘，落昂坪經心經簡林接大佛。
summary.en: Hong Kong's second-highest summit (934 m). A punishing staircase from Pak Kung Au, then down past the Wisdom Path to the Big Buddha at Ngong Ping.

highlights.en: Big Buddha and Ngong Ping Village

startTransport.zh: 3M／11／23 號巴士「伯公坳」下車
startTransport.en: Bus 3M/11/23 to Pak Kung Au

endTransport.zh: 昂坪乘 23 號巴士往東涌或纜車下山
endTransport.en: Bus 23 or the cable car from Ngong Ping

summary.zh: 由山頂廣場起步，沿百年盧吉道棧道繞山一圈，維港兩岸就在腳下。全程平緩有樹蔭，黃昏來可一次看日落與夜景。
summary.en: The classic Peak circuit: a century-old cliffside boardwalk with the harbour at your feet, flat and shaded, best at dusk when the lights come on.

startTransport.zh: 中環乘山頂纜車或 15 號巴士至山頂廣場
startTransport.en: Peak Tram or bus 15 from Central to Peak Galleria

endTransport.zh: 山頂廣場乘纜車／15 號巴士下山
endTransport.en: Peak Tram or bus 15 back down

note.en: Old Peak Road down to Central

summary.zh: 深水埗後山，90 米高，20 分鐘登頂。黃昏時整個深水埗舊區與獅子山同框，是市區最就腳的日落位。
summary.en: Sham Shui Po's 90 m backyard hill: 20 minutes up for a dusk view over the old blocks with Lion Rock behind.

highlights.zh: 舊區天台與獅子山同框
highlights.en: Old rooftops framed by Lion Rock

startTransport.zh: 深水埗站 B2 出口步行 8 分鐘
startTransport.en: Sham Shui Po MTR exit B2, 8 min walk

endTransport.zh: 原路落深水埗站
endTransport.en: Back down to Sham Shui Po MTR

summary.zh: 香港最高瀑布群：井底瀑、中瀑、主瀑逐級而上，主瀑落差 35 米。沿溪谷石階而行，樹蔭濃密，夏天特別涼快。
summary.en: Hong Kong's tallest waterfall chain — Bottom, Middle and Main falls, the last dropping 35 m. A shaded stone-step climb up a stream valley.

highlights.en: Mossy stone steps through the ravine
Extend up to Tai Mo Shan

startTransport.zh: 64K 巴士「梧桐寨」站下車，步行 15 分鐘入村
startTransport.en: Bus 64K to Ng Tung Chai stop, 15 min into the village

endTransport.zh: 原路返回梧桐寨村乘 64K
endTransport.en: Back to the village for bus 64K

note.en: No shop; stock up in Tai Po Market

summary.zh: 沿鶴咀道走到香港最東南角：1875 年燈塔、海蝕洞蟹洞、戰時炮台與海洋保護區。路平易走，但沿途無樹蔭。
summary.en: A flat road walk to Hong Kong's south-eastern tip: an 1875 lighthouse, the Sea Cave, wartime batteries and a marine reserve.

startTransport.zh: 14 號巴士「鶴咀道」下車
startTransport.en: Bus 14 to Cape D'Aguilar Road

endTransport.zh: 原路返回鶴咀道乘 14 號巴士
endTransport.en: Back to the road for bus 14

note.en: No shop; resupply at Shek O
Turn back anywhere on the road

district.en: Clear Water Bay · Po Toi O

summary.zh: 西貢三尖之一，344 米山頂如三角尖锥。由五塊田上廟仔墩，攀頂後沿脊落布袋澳，清水灣與牛尾海一路相伴。
summary.en: One of Sai Kung's three sharp peaks. Up from Ng Fai Tin, a short rocky scramble to the summit, then a ridge descent to Po Toi O with Clear Water Bay below.

highlights.en: 360° sea view from the pointed summit
Seafood village at Po Toi O

startTransport.zh: 91 號巴士「五塊田」下車
startTransport.en: Bus 91 to Ng Fai Tin

endTransport.zh: 布袋澳乘 16 號小巴往坑口
endTransport.en: Minibus 16 from Po Toi O to Hang Hau

district.en: Sok Kwu Wan · Yung Shue Wan

summary.zh: 索罟灣落船，經天后宮、洪聖爺灣泳灘，橫過山坳到榕樹灣。全程石屎徑，沿途海鮮酒家與咖啡店，適合一家大細。
summary.en: Ferry into Sok Kwu Wan, past Tin Hau Temple and Hung Shing Yeh beach, over the hill to Yung Shue Wan. Paved throughout, with seafood and cafes at both ends.

startTransport.zh: 中環 4 號碼頭渡輪往索罟灣
startTransport.en: Ferry from Central Pier 4 to Sok Kwu Wan

endTransport.zh: 榕樹灣渡輪返中環
endTransport.en: Ferry from Yung Shue Wan to Central

summary.zh: 西貢碼頭街渡 15 分鐘到橋咀洲，退潮時連島沙洲露出水面，可步行至橋頭。沿家樂徑上山頂看牛尾海，夏日可浮潛。
summary.en: A 15-minute kaito from Sai Kung pier to Sharp Island. At low tide a tombolo emerges to Kiu Tau; a short trail climbs for views over Port Shelter.

highlights.en: The tombolo, only at low tide

highlights.zh: 橋咀洲地質公園火山岩

startTransport.zh: 西貢碼頭街渡（約 15 分鐘，班次以當日為準）
startTransport.en: Kaito from Sai Kung pier (15 min, schedule varies)

endTransport.zh: 橋咀碼頭街渡返西貢
endTransport.en: Kaito back to Sai Kung

summary.zh: 由油塘上炮台山，探 1900 年代魔鬼山炮台與歌賦炮台遺蹟，維港東入口與鯉魚門海峽就在腳下，落山去三家村食海鮮。
summary.en: Up from Yau Tong to the 1900s Devil's Peak redoubt and Gough Battery, over the eastern harbour entrance, down to Lei Yue Mun for seafood.

startTransport.zh: 油塘站 A2 出口步行 15 分鐘
startTransport.en: Yau Tong MTR exit A2, 15 min walk

endTransport.zh: 三家村乘小巴或步行返油塘站
endTransport.en: Minibus or walk from Sam Ka Tsuen to Yau Tong

summary.zh: 屯門後山 583 米，山形如金字塔。由青山寺上攀，山脊浮沙碎石，腹地黃沙如沙漠，落良景邨。需一定攀爬經驗。
summary.en: Tuen Mun's 583 m pyramid. A steep climb from Castle Peak Monastery, a loose sandy ridge across the interior, then down to Leung King Estate.

highlights.zh: 金字塔山形與屯門海岸
highlights.en: The pyramid profile over Tuen Mun

startTransport.zh: 屯門站乘 43 號小巴至青山寺
startTransport.en: Minibus 43 from Tuen Mun to Castle Peak Monastery

endTransport.zh: 良景邨乘輕鐵／巴士返屯門
endTransport.en: Light Rail or bus from Leung King back to Tuen Mun

summary.zh: 八個山峰連成一線，如八仙過海。由新娘潭上犁壁山，沿刃脊走過純陽峰至仙姑峰，再落大美督。全程無遮蔭，上落頻密。
summary.en: Eight named peaks in a row above Plover Cove. From Bride's Pool up to the knife-edge ridge, across all eight summits, then down to Tai Mei Tuk.

startTransport.zh: 75K／275R（假日）巴士至新娘潭
startTransport.en: Bus 75K/275R (Sundays) to Bride's Pool

endTransport.zh: 大美督乘 75K 巴士或 20C 小巴往大埔墟
endTransport.en: Bus 75K or minibus 20C from Tai Mei Tuk to Tai Po Market

note.en: Descend to Bride's Pool or Tai Mei Tuk

summary.zh: 由大欖涌水塘主壩出發，沿水塘道經吉慶橋古橋，接大欖涌郊遊徑上大棠。水塘是戰後首個大型水庫，湖中群島即「千島湖」。
summary.en: From the main dam along the reservoir road, across the old Kat Hing Bridge, then up the Tai Lam Chung country trail to Tai Tong.

startTransport.zh: 61M／53 號巴士「大欖涌」下車
startTransport.en: Bus 61M/53 to Tai Lam Chung

endTransport.zh: 大棠乘 68R 或的士往元朗
endTransport.en: Bus 68R or taxi from Tai Tong to Yuen Long

summary.zh: 港島徑第六段的精華：大潭篤、大潭中、大潭副水塘四座百年水壩串連，石橋與紅磚泵房在林中，末段上大風坳落柏架山道。
summary.en: The best of Hong Kong Trail Section 6: four century-old dams, stone bridges and a red-brick pump house, finishing over Quarry Gap to Mount Parker Road.

highlights.en: Tai Tam Tuk dam and stone bridges

startTransport.zh: 14 號巴士「大潭水塘」下車
startTransport.en: Bus 14 to Tai Tam Reservoir

endTransport.zh: 柏架山道落鰂魚涌站
endTransport.en: Mount Parker Road down to Quarry Bay MTR

summary.zh: 沿大嶼山北岸的古道由東涌走到大澳，經沙螺灣、深屈的紅樹林與海邊村落，最後入大澳棚屋。路平緩，風景不斷。
summary.en: The old coastal path from Tung Chung to Tai O via Sha Lo Wan and Sham Wat's mangroves — flat, varied, ending among Tai O's stilt houses.

highlights.en: Sham Wat's shore and oyster beds
Tai O stilt houses at sunset

startTransport.zh: 東涌站步行至逸東邨起步
startTransport.en: Tung Chung MTR, walk via Yat Tung Estate

endTransport.zh: 大澳乘 11 號巴士返東涌或渡輪往屯門
endTransport.en: Bus 11 to Tung Chung or ferry to Tuen Mun
